title: What is UpDown?
excerpt: A document on UpDown, the free multiplayer markdown editor.
content_html:
Password

Changing it signs out every other browser. It cannot be recovered, so keep it safe.

Anyone with the URL will be able to read and edit. All links below stop working.

Main link

Without the password, someone with this link can:

Reader link

A separate link with its own password, for people who should only read.

Editor link

A separate link with its own password, for people who should edit but not own.

People

Send someone their own link and password by email. You can take it away again without affecting anyone else.

Changes

Versions are saved as the document changes and kept for a month. Compare any of them with what is there now, to see what editors did.

Daily email

On days when there are new comments or someone else has edited, one short email says so. It gives how many comments and that there were edits, never what anyone wrote.

You will need the master password to get back in.
